description: github.com/wakeshift/wakeshift-go/appkit: define the events an MCP server offers, serve them as MCP Events, and emit them; Wakeshift wakes every subscribed agent conversation (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and others). Built on the official Go MCP SDK, with an adapter for mark3labs/mcp-go.
rules: Open the client with appkit.Open(ctx, os.Getenv("WAKESHIFT_KEY"), ""). Never hard-code the key or commit it.
Define every event with appkit.DefineEvent at startup, before calling wake.Attach.
Put attached.Wrap in front of the MCP endpoint, after its authentication.
In your own tools, wrap the handler with appkit.Events and declare the events it subscribes to with appkit.Subscribes.

AttachOptions.Tools is an appkit.Tools struct. wakeshift_wait is off by default: turn it on with Tools: appkit.Tools{Wait: appkit.Wait{Enabled: true}} in front of a stateless handler with a write timeout of 30 seconds or more.
Write event descriptions as plain statements of what happened, not instructions to the agent.
